Stepwise covariate modelling (SCM)

pk_scm.Rd

Forward inclusion followed by backward elimination, starting from a base run. Every model that is fitted is a regular run in the ledger (stage "scm"), with the current model as parent, so the complete search is documented in the run tree. The step table is stored in scm/<scm_id>.rds.

Usage

pk_scm(
  base,
  candidates,
  forward_p = NULL,
  backward_p = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  est = NULL,
  require_cov_step = TRUE,
  inits_from_parent = TRUE,
  decide_trials = TRUE,
  fit_fun = NULL,
  quiet = FALSE,
  proj = NULL
)

Arguments

base

Base run (reference or id), completed.

candidates

Tibble with one row per covariate relationship and the columns param, covariate, form, ref (for power and linear) and init. Relationships with a fixed parameter are not supported (a likelihood-ratio test needs a free parameter).

forward_p, backward_p

Significance levels (1 df). Defaults from the scm section of config.yml.

data

Data frame. Default: the registered dataset.

est

Estimation settings, see pk_est().

require_cov_step

Only select candidates whose model has a successful covariance step in the forward step?

inits_from_parent

Start each trial model from the final estimates of the current model?

decide_trials

Mark non-selected trial runs as rejected?

fit_fun, quiet, proj

See pk_run().

Value

A pk_scm object: a list with steps (tibble), final (run reference of the final model), selected, forward_selected, criteria, and scm_id.

Details

Forward step: all remaining candidates are added one at a time to the current model; the candidate with the largest drop in OFV is included if the drop exceeds the chi-square criterion with 1 df at forward_p (default 0.01, dOFV > 6.63). Backward step: each included candidate is removed one at a time; the one with the smallest increase in OFV is removed if the increase is below the criterion at backward_p (default 0.001, dOFV > 10.83).

Runs that were not selected in a step are marked as rejected (with the dOFV in the reason) when decide_trials = TRUE; runs on the selected path stay pending so that the analyst records the decision.

Examples

# \donttest{
cands <- tibble::tribble(
  ~param, ~covariate, ~form   , ~ref, ~init,
  "cl"  , "WT"      , "power" , 70  , 0.75 ,
  "cl"  , "CRCL"    , "power" , 100 , 0.1  ,
  "v2"  , "WT"      , "power" , 70  , 1
)
# scm <- pk_scm(base_run, cands)
# }
